_about: Permission rules that name machine paths. The academy's workspace bootstrap (academy/scripts/workspace_bootstrap.py, run through a workspace's scripts/bootstrap.py shim) renders them into each home's git-ignored .claude/settings.local.json (Claude Code cannot expand variables inside settings.json rules), after merging the workspace's own workspace.permissions.json (same keys; its rules are appended). Placeholders: {EACH_HOME} expands to one rule per home of the workspace, {ROOT} academy repo, {WORKSPACE} the workspace root (where the scripts/ship.py shim lives), {BOARD}, {LIBRARY}, {SCIENTIST} scientist home, {AUTHOR} author home, {USER} the user's home directory. A 'Bash(py ...)' rule also gets its PowerShell twin (forward slashes become backslashes), and one whose script path is relative a second, forward-slash PowerShell twin; 'PS:' rules are PowerShell-only. The key 'workspace' is rendered, alone (not with 'common'), into the workspace root's own settings.local.json: the safe scripts/ship.py verbs (merge, publish and accept-baseline are deliberately absent, so they always prompt), in the absolute form and in the relative form a session at the root types. 'Read(...)' and 'Edit(...)' paths are written in the //c/... form.
author: Bash(py {ROOT}/author/scripts/check_paper.py*)
Bash(py {ROOT}/academy/scripts/registry.py*)
Read({SCIENTIST}/**)
